title: Abdelaziz Awad
text: I am a highly motivated biomedical researcher with established expertise in data analysis and visualization. I am proficient in Unix-based environments, R, Python and C++, with experience in version control and in building reproducible, automated workflows. I also have hands-on experience applying machine learning and deep learning in real-world projects, from model development through to deployment (MLOps).

title: Abdelaziz Awad
text:
What I share here
This site is where I share science and write practical, step-by-step tutorials on:

Clinical Research: study design, systematic reviews and meta-analysis, and evidence synthesis
Data Science: statistics, data analysis and visualization in R and Python
Bioinformatics: working with biological and omics data, pipelines and reproducible analysis
AI: machine learning and artificial intelligence in medicine and research

I also post Research Opportunities: open projects you can join as a collaborator.

title: Welcome to my website
text:
Welcome! Posts here are organised into four topics:

Clinical Research — research methods, systematic reviews and meta-analysis, and how-to guides
Data Science — statistics and tutorials in R and Python
AI — artificial intelligence in medicine and research, and tools worth knowing
Bioinformatics — analysing biological and omics data

I also post Research Opportunities: open research projects you can join. Find them under Posts → Research Opportunities.
